description: Summarize a local GGUF or safetensors model: architecture, parameter count, quantization, context length, file size, tensor count. Reads only headers — inspecting a 70 GB model is instant. Works on extension-less GGUF blobs (e.g. Ollama's).

path.description: Path to a .gguf or .safetensors file, a *.safetensors.index.json, or a model directory

name: inspect_model
title: Inspect a local model file
